transcription: It's not like the relationships have been pressure or anything. In myself, I feel like there's less pressure. I'm a lot happier. I don't know. I think I'm better at being on my own than with someone, so yeah, I'm cool with being on my own.

More significantly, the content of her speech is highly introspective, demonstrating a willingness to explore and articulate complex internal emotional states.
